Description
A leading modern university with a distinctive offer across a wide range of creative, sport, health, education, technology, life sciences and business disciplines. We draw our inspiration from over 150 years of commitment to education as a force for good in the Cardiff Capital Region and beyond. We move forward as vibrant learning and research community with a focus on student success.
